notes: After three remote steals the Runner sat on 20-40 credits clicking for credits for six turns, never installed a breaker or ran R&D/HQ, and let the Corp advance and score the final Witch Hunt unopposed.
Won by grinding R&D against a broke Corp, but repeatedly tanked Phoneutria net damage on a small grip, ran known Urtica/Vicsek setups early, and wasted many clicks on low-value credit/tag cycles.
Clicked for credits nearly every turn from turn 2 to 18, reaching 69 credits without installing a single card or running R&D/HQ, while the Corp scored five agendas from one remote.
Quick HQ-focused win with Marjanah and Docklands Pass; minor oddities include installing a second Marjanah and a Tread Lightly run that jacked out for nothing.

Won via R&D pressure, but spent much of the midgame in an inefficient loop of taking two Starlit Knight tags per run and paying clicks and credits to clear them, plus passive credit-clicking turns and a pointless Concerto jack-out.

Looped double HQ runs every turn where the second run was always blanked by Vertigo, declined to spend a click to steal Meliès when it had clicks left, and never contested the remote where the Corp scored four agendas including the winning Meliès.
Aggressive and efficient, using Into the Depths for value, tutoring Gauss to break Klevetnik and stealing remotes promptly; tag management slightly loose but harmless.

Strong opening on open servers, then clicked for credits for eight turns up to 43 credits with no installs and no runs on an R&D still guarded by unrezzed ice, while the Corp scored three agendas from remotes.

Hoarded up to 35 credits clicking for credits nearly every turn, never ran central servers, and twice let an advanced Lotus Haze sit in a remote it had already proven it could break into, losing to the second one.
Good pressure on HQ and R&D with Katorga and Chastushka gutting HQ and steady R&D runs to win; installing a duplicate Boi-tatá was a minor waste.
Clean, fast win using Tao Salonga swaps to move Paywall around, stealing from remote and HQ and ignoring tags to close out on turn 4.
Built a cheap Buzzsaw/Leech rig and ground out R&D and HQ steals; double facecheck of HQ and R&D into Afshar without a decoder cost tempo and credits.
Good early R&D dig, then clicked for credits for eight turns up to 41 credits without installing a breaker or running anywhere while the Corp scored three more agendas.

Clicked for credits for twelve straight turns up to 64 credits with no installs, then finally ran the match-point remote, ate 4 net damage through Karuna and jacked out before accessing the agenda that won the Corp the game.
Solid rig of Revolver, Shibboleth and Tremolo with good R&D/HQ pressure and a clean final remote break; it was briefly too poor to contest two remote scores mid-game.

Ran the same Ansel-protected remote eleven times, each time unable to steal because of Ansel's subroutine and losing its whole rig, rather than pressuring the open R&D or HQ, and the Corp won on turn 8.
Used Banner cleverly to push through a three-ice remote and steal four agendas; a turn-1 facecheck left it broke and Hammer ate several resources, but the plan was coherent.

After a good Fujii steal it clicked for credits for eight turns up to 47 credits with breakers installed, never contesting the remotes where the Corp advanced and scored three Sericulture Expansions over multiple turns.
Quick win: early R&D steal, trashed Otto Campaigns, then Red Team runs on HQ with Docklands Pass found two agendas.

Clicked for credits for about fifteen turns up to 56 credits without installing breakers or running R&D/HQ, while the Corp advanced and scored agendas in remotes over multiple turns, finishing with Cryptocrash.
